
```{julia}
using CurrentSheetTestParticle
using DrWatson

begin
    θ = 45
    v = 8
    β = 90
    d = @dict(θ, β, v)
    diffeq = (; dtmax=1e-3)
    init_kwargs = (; Nw=8, Nϕ=32)
    sols, (wϕs, B) = solve_params(RDProblemParams(; diffeq, init_kwargs, d...))
end;
```


```{julia}
using CurrentSheetTestParticle: field_lines_distance, field_lines_asym_distance, _field_lines_asym_distance

dists = map(sols) do sol
    field_lines_asym_distance(sol, B)
end

dR_perp_asym_approx = map(sols) do sol
    _field_lines_asym_distance(sol, B)
end


plot(dR_perp_asym_approx - getindex.(dists, :dR_perp_asym))
```

```{julia}
using CairoMakie
using AlgebraOfGraphics
using DataFrames, DataFramesMeta
df = DataFrame(dists)
@info "Statistics" maximum(df.dR_perp_min) maximum(df.dR_perp_asym)
@chain df begin
    @transform! :wϕ = wϕs
    @rtransform! :w0 = :wϕ[1]
end
spec = data(df) * AlgebraOfGraphics.density() * (mapping(:dR_perp_asym) * mapping(; color=:w0 => nonnumeric))
draw(spec)
```
